swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): A potato piece placed in a concentrated salt solution shrinks. Reason (R): Water moves out of the potato's cells into the salt solution by osmosis, since the solution has a higher solute concentration than the cell's contents.

add.q: Assertion (A): A potato piece placed in plain water swells. Reason (R): Robert Hooke first observed and named cells in 1665 while examining thin slices of cork under a self-designed microscope. Choose the correct option.
add.a: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
o: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false

swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): Mature human red blood cells cannot repair or divide. Reason (R): They lack a nucleus, which normally contains the genetic material needed to direct these processes.

add.q: Assertion (A): Mature human red blood cells cannot repair or divide. Reason (R): This is because mature red blood cells retain a nucleus that has become permanently inactive and stops directing repair or division. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is true, R is false
o: A is true, R is false
A is false, R is true
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A

swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): Leaf cells contain many chloroplasts, but root cells contain very few. Reason (R): Chloroplasts carry out photosynthesis, which requires sunlight that root cells (underground) do not receive.

add.q: Assertion (A): Leucoplasts are double-membrane-bound organelles that contain the green pigment chlorophyll and carry out photosynthesis in plant cells. Reason (R): Leucoplasts are colourless plastids that store food such as starch, oils or proteins, as seen in potato and taro. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is false, R is true
o: A is false, R is true
